summaries.zh: Orkas是一款开源（MIT）的本地AI团队，适用于桌面端。通过“指挥官”将目标转化为任务，协调16个内置专家代理（包括Claude Code、Codex等）及项目、定时自动化和连接器。支持macOS和Windows，可使用内置模型或自定义API密钥。该应用免费，在GitHub上获5960星和360次分叉。
summaries.en: Orkas is an open-source, local-first AI desktop application (MIT license) for macOS and Windows. It features a Commander that converts goals into tasks and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Hermes. Users can manage projects, schedule automations, and use connectors. The app supports built-in models or custom API keys. It has 5,960 stars and 360 forks on GitHub.
